# Earned Escape

> Trips planned around how you travel, including family cruises, theme parks, Europe and Asia. Sports Event Packages. Operated by COTIB Adventures LLC and affiliated with Castle Dreams Travel through Charles Betancourt, Independent Advisor.

Earned Escape plans trips around how you travel: family cruises, theme park vacations, active and outdoor trips, Europe and Asia. Every trip gets luxury-level care, whatever the style or budget. Trips booked through my suppliers are planned at no extra fee.

## Who We Serve

- **Family cruises and theme park trips**: Multi-generational family trips, milestone celebrations, and first-time cruisers who want a smoother experience.
- **Active travel, Europe and Asia**: Active and outdoor trips, plus Europe and Asia, planned around how you like to travel.
- **Support models**: Full-Service Planning (hands-on, start to finish) or Advisory / Light-Touch Support (strategy and second opinion while the traveler books directly). Trips booked through my suppliers are planned at no extra fee.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage (/)](https://earnedescape.agency/): Overview of trips planned around how you travel, personal travel story, and our interactive travel vibe selector.
- [About Us (/about)](https://earnedescape.agency/about): The COTIB Story. Founder Chuck Betancourt's background: traveling the world since age six, 25+ years of corporate IT systems planning applied to travel, credentials and experience, and the vision of COTIB Adventures LLC as a family legacy.
- [Plan Your Escape (/plan)](https://earnedescape.agency/plan): Book a free 30-minute Vacation Planning Call with Chuck via Google Calendar. Covers family cruises, theme parks, and other trips planned around how you travel. Leads auto-ingest into Tern CRM.
- [Compliance (/compliance)](https://earnedescape.agency/compliance): Licensing, business registration (New Jersey), and official affiliate disclosures as an independent contractor of Castle Dreams Travel through Charles Betancourt, Independent Advisor.

## Destinations & Planning Guides

### Cruises

- [Royal Caribbean (/royal-caribbean)](https://earnedescape.agency/royal-caribbean): Cruise planning shaped by firsthand sailings, from family staterooms to premium suites. Tips on stateroom selection, cruise classes, and itinerary planning.

### Sports events

- [Sports Event Packages (/sports)](https://earnedescape.agency/sports): Sports event travel packages through Roadtrips, including the Rose Bowl, Super Bowl, Daytona 500, Masters, Kentucky Derby, Indy 500, Monaco Grand Prix, Women's World Cup, Wimbledon, British Open, and Ryder Cup. Dates and from prices per person, double occupancy, subject to change, as shown on roadtrips.com and checked October 18, 2026. Quotes start at /plan.

### Asia

- [China (/china)](https://earnedescape.agency/china): Can Americans visit China without a visa? Yes, for up to 10 days, if you fly on to a third country or region. How China's 240-hour transit works for US passports, when you need a tourist visa instead, and the payment, phone and arrival steps to sort first, plus a free printable China entry checklist by email. Facts last checked October 18, 2026. Planning calls start at /plan.

### Theme parks

- [Theme parks (/theme-parks)](https://earnedescape.agency/theme-parks): Theme park trip planning hub. Each destination has its own section and planning page. Trips booked through my suppliers are planned at no extra fee.
- [Universal Orlando (/universal)](https://earnedescape.agency/universal): Vacation planning for Universal Orlando and the new Epic Universe theme park, featuring hotel recommendations and park strategy.

### Disney

- [Disney Cruise Line (/disney-cruise-line)](https://earnedescape.agency/disney-cruise-line): Disney Cruise Line planning for families and multigenerational groups. Details on ships (like the Disney Fantasy), onboard rotations, and how to tell if DCL fits your family.
- [Walt Disney World (/disney-world)](https://earnedescape.agency/disney-world): Walt Disney World planning guide. Recommends a resort-first layout, rope drop strategies, selective Lightning Lane usage, and monorail resort insights.
